description: Create an Airflow 2.7+ DAG for genomics_lab that spins up an ephemeral EMR cluster, runs three Spark steps, and always terminates the cluster. Use setup/teardown tasks: 'create_cluster' as setup and 'terminate_cluster' as teardown, so that the cluster is terminated whether the steps succeed or fail, and the DAG run state reflects the work tasks, not the teardown. The three steps run sequentially: align, call_variants, annotate. If 'call_variants' fails, 'annotate' must not run, the cluster must still be terminated, and the DAG run must be marked failed.
edge_cases: Implementing cleanup as a plain task with trigger_rule='all_done' as the only leaf makes the DAG run succeed even when a step failed
If create_cluster itself fails there is no cluster id; terminate_cluster must handle the missing XCom without raising
Teardown must be scoped to the work tasks (setup >> work >> teardown with as_teardown(setups=...)) so clearing a step re-runs setup
Step retries must reuse the same cluster rather than create a new one
common_failure_modes: FM6: all_done cleanup leaf masks upstream failure and the DAG run is reported as success
FM6: Default all_success on terminate_cluster leaks a running cluster after any step failure
FM7: No check that the annotated output exists before reporting success
